integrity.computed_evidence: Exact rational boundary-point checks supplement, but do not establish, the universal symbolic proof.
integrity.scientific_claim_scope: A complete formula, exact centers, and sharp area/perimeter inequalities for nondegenerate Euclidean rhombi.

limitations: Euclidean rhombi only; no general-quadrilateral claim; published worldwide perimeter bound is not improved. Full text of Walter (2016) was not available for comparison. No independent mathematical audit.
title: A sharp 60-degree transition for the boundary self-Chebyshev radius of rhombi
